summary: Iter 86 — 'Login that NEVER breaks' hardening verified end-to-end. All 4 hardenings work: (1) JWT leeway=10 absorbs +5s clock skew but rejects +30s, (2) deprecated /api/webhook/stripe returns 410 Gone, (3) /api/internal/sync/health enforces X-Sync-Secret with timing-safe compare, (4) ReAuthModal opens on 'wladbot:reauth-required' event, shows user email + password input + Google button, close dispatches 'wladbot:reauth-cancelled'. Backend 10/10 pytest. Frontend full flow passes.

issues: Default landing on /login is REGISTER form (Account erstellen), not login. User must click small 'Anmelden' link to switch. For a 'never-breaks login' UX this should be the other way around — defaulting to SIGN-IN (the more common return-user flow) and offering 'Account erstellen' as the alt link. Not a blocker, but Mert may want this flipped for leader-os.de pre-launch.

action_items: OPTIONAL UX: Consider defaulting /login to sign-in mode (not register). Currently the 'never-breaks login' page lands on the register form, requiring an extra click for returning users.
OPTIONAL CLEANUP: 7 transient 401s show in browser console after login → /dashboard (onboarding endpoints firing before refresh interceptor finishes). Not user-visible but pollutes logs.
critical_code_review_comments: services.py:80 — jwt.decode(..., leeway=10) correctly absorbs ±10s clock skew. Verified live: +5s iat token accepted, +30s rejected.

routes/payments.py:313 — /api/webhook/stripe returns 410 with informative body pointing to Supabase Edge Function. Stripe Dashboard will now show errors loudly instead of silently. Good defensive design.
routes/sync.py:38-44 — _verify_secret uses secrets.compare_digest (timing-safe). Returns 503 when INBOUND_SYNC_SECRET unset (fail-closed) instead of accidental 200. Solid.

lib/api.js:60-105 — 401 interceptor checks sessionStorage('wladbot_user') BEFORE deciding modal vs hard redirect. Pending request is correctly held and retried after wladbot:reauth-success. Cancel path clears cache + rejects. Race-safe via single isRefreshing flag.

ReAuthModal.js — Listens only when user.email exists (correct — cold sessions fall back to /login). Lazy-loads /auth/providers when modal opens (no upfront network cost). Close button correctly dispatches wladbot:reauth-cancelled (verified live).

OAuthButtons.js:64-156 — scriptStatus state machine (loading|ready|failed) + retry on click + hidden Google-rendered button as One-Tap fallback. Robust against script load failure and FedCM/cookie suppression.
